Sandbox_KnoxMobile_AlarmRadius_tooltip: How far zombies hear a ringing phone alarm, in tiles, at full volume (less at lower volume, half from a bag or container). Alarms ring wherever the phone is, so a phone can be a lure. 0: zombies never hear alarms.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_AllowPrivateRepeaters: Owners can lock their repeater with a password.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_BatteryLifeMultiplier: Multiplies how long a charge lasts. A modern phone lasts 2-3 days of mixed use at 1.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_BatteryWear_tooltip: Each full charge cycle wears the battery a little.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_BoxedPhones_tooltip: Multiplies the new phones in their boxes, found only in electronics stores. At 1, a legendary find.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_CarrierAlerts_tooltip: KNOX MOBILE ALERT texts warn of power and water shutoffs, the helicopter, severe weather and the news of the first days. Only phones with service get them, and they stop when the towers die.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_ClassifiedsDays_toolt: How many in-game days a Classifieds listing stays up.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_DamageMultiplier_tool: Multiplies the chance that drops and falls damage phones.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_DropChance_tooltip: Chance (percent) to drop the phone when a zombie grabs you or you stumble.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_EraLimit_tooltip: Which phones exist. 1993 only: just the brick phones of July 1993.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_ExactChargersForOldPh: Phones need the charger or cable that fits their socket. Off: any charger fits any phone.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_FamilyHunt_tooltip: Your family's texts name a real building in Knox County. Once their last text arrives, go there to find out what happened: who turned (with their phone and your unread texts), a note and their car, or nobody at all. Needs the family storyline.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_FamilyStoryline_toolt: Your family texts you over the first days.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_FindMyCrew_tooltip: Phones that opt in show group members who also opted in as a rough direction and distance, worked out from the towers or a repeater. Both phones need service.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_FlashlightDrain_toolt: Multiplies the extra battery a smartphone's flashlight uses. At 1 the light costs nearly as much as the screen. 0: the light is free.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_FoundPhoneChargeMax_t: Highest battery charge (percent) on phones found in the world.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_FoundPhoneChargeMin_t: Lowest battery charge (percent) on phones found in the world.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_FoundPhoneHealthMax_t: Highest battery health (percent) on found phones.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_FoundPhoneHealthMin_t: Lowest battery health (percent) on found phones.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_GradualCollapse_toolt: Towers die one by one, rural towers first.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_HearingPenalty_toolti: Earbuds and headphones make it harder to hear the world.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_HousePhones_tooltip: Multiplies the used phones in houses, offices and car glove boxes. At 1, about one house in 2-3 has a phone.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_NetworkCongestion_too: Early on, calls sometimes fail with "All circuits are busy".
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_NoiseMultiplier_toolt: Multiplies how far zombies hear phone speakers and ringtones.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_PowerBankCapacity_too: How many full modern-phone charges a power bank holds.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_PristineMidPhones_too: Percent of found 2003-2009 phones without a scratch.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_PristineOldPhones_too: Percent of found 1993-2000 phones without a scratch. The rest are scratched, cracked or broken.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_PristineSmartphones_t: Percent of found smartphones without a scratch. At 4, a pristine smartphone is about 1 found phone in 100.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_QuestTrapChance_toolt: Some survivor texts point to a stash at a real pharmacy, gas station or police station. This is the chance (percent) that one is a trap: far more zombies, or the survivor dead and the bag picked over. Needs survivor texts.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_QueueMessages_tooltip: Texts to unreachable phones wait and arrive when they connect.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_RarityMultiplier_tool: Multiplies how often phones and accessories spawn (everything below too).
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_RepeaterRange_tooltip: How far a player-built repeater reaches, in tiles, from the ground floor.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_RepeaterSkill_tooltip: Electrical level needed to build a repeater.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_RiceTrick_tooltip: A day sealed in rice dries a damp or lightly water-damaged phone.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_RoofSignal_tooltip: Multiplies how much higher floors and roofs improve signal. 0: height makes no difference.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_ServiceCollapseDays_t: With "Days after the grid": days after the power grid fails until the last tower dies. With "On a fixed day": the game day it dies.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_SmartphoneShare_toolt: Percent of found phones that are smartphones (PearPhone, Supernova).
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_SosRange_tooltip: How far an SOS reaches strangers' phones, in tiles, when strangers get it. Your groups and contacts get it wherever they are.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_SosToStrangers_toolti: An SOS also goes to every phone within the SOS range, not just your groups and contacts.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_StartWithOwnSim_toolt: Every character starts with their SIM card (and family contacts) in their wallet.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_StartingPhone_tooltip: Whether characters start with a phone.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_StoryDarkness_tooltip: How often family members die in the family storyline.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_StumbleChance_tooltip: How often you stumble while sprinting with the phone up (0 = never).
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_SurvivorTexts_tooltip: Strangers text about places with supplies or danger.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_TowerFuelUse_tooltip: Multiplies the extra generator fuel a restored tower's radio equipment burns. At 1, with the game's default generator fuel use, a full tank runs a tower about four days. 0: no extra fuel.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_TowerRestore_tooltip: A running generator hooked up at a dead tower's cell site (right-click near the site) brings that tower back on the air while it has fuel. Manuals list the sites.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_WaterDamage_tooltip: Long exposure to rain ruins damp phones.
Sandbox_KnoxMobile_ZombiePhoneChance_too: Percent of killed zombies with a phone on them.
